scope.focus: Project-Frankenstein visual lineage: two-stage adaptive compute escalation -> unified FrankEye -> screenshot-specific cleanup -> Qwen3.5 native multimodal bridge; explicit comparison against current Frank v0.1 adaptive personal visual-learning requirement

lineage.event: Introduced an Adaptive Visual Pipeline with Stage 1 fast YOLO/OCR/scene heuristics and Stage 2 VLM only when confidence/question heuristics requested escalation, plus region capture and legacy fallback integration.

The implementation's adaptivity is routing/escalation adaptivity: confidence is reduced by no detections, unclear scene, low detector confidence, people without context, photo/no-text, semantic-question classes, complex scenes and screenshot/no-text; text-heavy screenshots and labeled diagrams can bypass VLM. Runtime stats track total images, pipeline-only images, escalations and latency/save rate. No persistent user-specific class/prototype learner is present in the inspected file.
Deleted the separate visual pipeline/adaptive-vision/VCB files and replaced them with a unified FrankEye path using DINOv2 INT8 ONNX, consistent with a module-collapse/resource simplification step.

Specialized FrankEye for screenshots: app/browser-tab detection, OCR preprocessing for dark themes, recognition of Frank's own WebUI and removal of CIFAR-10 classification described as useless for screenshots.
Migrated vision again toward a native_vision pipeline as the architecture moved to Qwen3.5 multimodal inference.

Frozen-head NativeVision is a direct Qwen3.5-4B multimodal bridge over llama-server. It explicitly replaces FrankEye and removes CNN/DINOv2/ONNX/Tesseract dependencies, providing fixed/default/deep/OCR prompt modes and image-to-chat-completions transport. The inspected file contains no persistent personal familiarity/prototype/classifier learning state.

mechanism_findings.finding: Historical 'adaptive vision' primarily meant adaptive compute escalation, not online user-specific visual category learning.
The two-stage design encoded a reusable confidence-budget mechanism: cheap perception first, expensive semantic vision only when uncertainty/task type justified escalation.
The visual stack repeatedly collapsed components as model/runtime capability changed: detector/OCR+VLM -> unified FrankEye -> native Qwen multimodal bridge.
Screenshot perception benefited from task-specific semantics and preprocessing rather than generic image classification.

negative_results_and_counterexamples.result: CIFAR-10 classification was explicitly removed from screenshot analysis as useless output.
negative_results_and_counterexamples.impact: Generic closed-set labels can add noise without helping the actual user task. Current visual learning should optimize familiarity/useful task distinctions rather than arbitrary benchmark classes.

negative_results_and_counterexamples.result: The historical Adaptive Visual Pipeline's confidence function is hand-coded from detector/OCR/scene/question heuristics and the inspected implementation records usage statistics but no learned calibration update.
negative_results_and_counterexamples.impact: A static confidence heuristic may route efficiently but is not evidence of personalized familiarity learning or calibrated open-set recognition.

negative_results_and_counterexamples.result: The frozen-head native vision bridge is stateless at the inspected visual interface: image + prompt -> multimodal model response, without persistent trusted-example lineage, class/prototype versioning, open-set calibration or rollback state in this file.
negative_results_and_counterexamples.impact: Current Frank v0.1 adaptive Micro Visual Classifier/cyclic learner cannot be considered inherited merely because native multimodal perception exists. A separate typed learner/state contract remains required unless equivalent functionality is found elsewhere in the corpus.

critical_disambiguation.historical_pf_meaning_observed: dynamic escalation between cheap fast perception and expensive VLM based on heuristic confidence/task triggers
critical_disambiguation.current_frank_v0_1_requirement: adaptive user-specific Micro Visual Classifier/cyclic learner with trusted examples, familiarity/known/unknown/conflict semantics, versioning, calibration and rollback
critical_disambiguation.rule: Do not credit the historical adaptive-routing mechanism as completion of the current personal visual-learning requirement. Reuse routing ideas separately from learner-state requirements.

current_inheritance.delta: Reuse the cheap-first/escalate-on-uncertainty architecture, but add explicit personal learner state: feature-backbone identity, prototype/classifier version, trusted-example provenance/tier, known/unknown/conflict output, calibration, candidate promotion and last-known-good rollback.

Visual routing is a concrete precedent for uncertainty- and task-sensitive escalation. Replace fixed keyword/confidence heuristics with measured calibration where beneficial, while preserving deterministic fallback and latency/resource receipts.

Regressionize text-heavy screenshot fast path, unclear-scene escalation, generic-classification-noise rejection, dark-theme OCR/screenshot handling, own-UI recognition, native-model fallback, and explicit distinction between perception success and learner-state update success.

Model perception and personal learning as separate typed transitions: perceive(image, task) may return evidence/uncertainty; learn(example, trust, class/prototype version) is a separate authorized state mutation with promotion/rollback semantics.

Native multimodal outputs are observations, not familiarity truth. Persist learner examples/features/prototypes/calibration/version/rollback lineage separately from raw image evidence and transient model descriptions.
Associate repeated visual evidence and personal familiarity classes through provenance-bearing edges, but do not infer 'known' merely from semantic similarity or repeated model descriptions.

cheap_discriminating_tests: Replay a text-heavy screenshot and a semantically ambiguous photo through cheap-first routing; measure escalation rate, latency and task accuracy separately.
Compare generic closed-set labels against task-specific screenshot/UI/OCR outputs on user tasks; generic labels should receive no credit unless they improve downstream decisions.
Present the same personally familiar object across lighting/background changes and unrelated lookalikes; require known/unknown/conflict calibration rather than free-form VLM confidence.
Freeze the multimodal model while updating only the personal Micro Visual Classifier; verify familiarity can improve without changing base perception semantics.
Corrupt or roll back a learner candidate and assert last-known-good prototype/classifier state restores deterministically with provenance intact.
Force native multimodal vision unavailable and verify the architecture degrades explicitly rather than silently converting missing perception into familiarity claims.

earned_work.reason: Strong reusable routing, perception and negative-result value, but current adaptive personal learner is not equivalent to historical adaptive escalation; reusable-hour credit requires dedup against existing Drive Retina/adaptive-learning mappings.

level0_effect.reason: Completed an additional Project-Frankenstein semantic/history visual lineage shard, but the repository-wide tree/history denominator remains unfrozen.
